hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On The Way
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or car in Sheffield? We'll have you back inside within the hour, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to key cutting and security upgrades, we handle every lock problem fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, car, or office? We arrive quickly with no call-out charge and get you back inside without damage.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or stiff locks repaired on the spot, or replaced with high-security alternatives. We use quality mechanisms built to last.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Spare keys cut while you wait. We stock blanks for homes, cars, and businesses, cut to exact specifications.

services.title: Cylinder & Deadlock Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade to anti-snap or anti-bump cylinders and secure your property against modern break-in techniques.

services.title: Burglary Repairs & Boarding
services.desc: After a break-in, we secure doors and windows immediately, replacing locks and boarding damaged frames.

services.title: UPVC & Composite Door Locks
services.desc: Specialist repairs and replacements for modern UPVC and composite doors, restoring security and smooth operation.

about_pullquote: I started this because Sheffield deserves a locksmith who shows up fast and charges fair prices.
about_para_1: Potter Locksmith has been keeping Sheffield homes and businesses secure for over 15 years. We built our reputation on reliability — arriving quickly when you need us most, solving lock problems without the inflated prices other locksmiths charge. Every member of the team is trained to the highest standard and carries everything needed to help you on the first visit.
about_para_2: Whether you're locked out at 3am or need to upgrade your locks after a break-in, we treat your emergency like our own. Hundreds of Sheffield families and business owners trust us because we answer the phone, we show up, and we fix the problem. No hidden fees, no unnecessary upsells — just honest locksmith work.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and Potter Locksmith picked up straight away. Bloke arrived in about 40 minutes, had the door open in minutes. Charged exactly what he quoted on the phone. Top service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called them at midnight after a break-in. They came out within an hour, boarded the door, replaced the lock, and made the place secure again. Professional, calm, and didn't charge the earth. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Lisa P.

reviews.text: Had my UPVC door lock jammed for weeks. Rather than replace the whole thing, Potter Locksmith fixed it for a fraction of the price. Quick turnaround and the lock works perfectly now. Honest tradesman.
reviews.author: David R.
